text: This solution, Climate Investment Funds – Pilot Program for Climate Resilience (PPCR) in Papua New Guinea addresses natural catastrophe in Papua New Guinea between Climate Change and Development Authority (CCDA), Government of Papua New Guinea, Climate Investment Funds (CIF), and Asian Development Bank (ADB). The program was implemented in 2015 and focuses on collaboration and raising awareness.
